# WebSocket close loses native fields and retries clean shutdowns

## Context

Promoted from Ada's unowned close-event defect note after an independent native WebSocket reproduction on the current Socket source (unchanged between the reviewed source and dev `4802862b7347ca7c55ca41685bbefedab784d7af`). #8012 defines the emitted close payload; #8177 defines automatic recovery from abnormal closure. The merged #18970 deliberately preserves the Neural Link client's ability to recover after a bridge goes away.

## The Problem

`beforeSetSocket` binds `onClose` as the native socket's `onclose`. That callback receives one CloseEvent, but `onClose(event, reason, wasClean)` reads the other two arguments. Both are undefined, and `!wasClean` consequently reconnects even after a clean code-1000 close.

Independent probe (real loopback server, reconnect budget limited to one for observation):

| Native close | Emitted reason / wasClean | Reconnect attempts |
|---|---|---|
| code 1000, reason `job complete`, wasClean true | undefined / undefined | 1 |
| code 1006, reason empty, wasClean false | undefined / undefined | 1 |

Correcting only the argument read would also silently remove clean-close recovery from the default Neural Link client. Its later window-return retry starts only after the socket exhausts a reconnect cycle.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/data/connection/WebSocket.mjs#beforeSetSocket` owns native callback binding; `#onClose` owns the observable payload and automatic retry decision.
- `src/ai/Client.mjs#connect` creates its socket through `ClassSystem.beforeSetInstance`; explicit object config overrides supplied defaults, while an existing instance retains its configuration.
- `Client#redial` is exhaustion-driven. An explicit opt-out of clean-close recovery must not be silently undone by a focus event.
- Existing tests: `unit/data/connection/WebSocket.spec.mjs` and `e2e/core/AiClientLateBridge.spec.mjs`.

## The Fix

Read `reason` and `wasClean` from CloseEvent and preserve the observable payload shape. Keep automatic abnormal-close recovery. Add `reconnectOnCleanClose: false` to the generic socket; the default socket created by the Neural Link client opts in explicitly.

An explicit false or a caller-supplied socket keeps its own clean-close policy. In the client, a clean close with that policy disabled ends automatic recovery, including implicit focus/visibility re-dials; it does not fabricate an exhausted retry cycle. No second retry scheduler or duplicated close predicate belongs in the client.

Prescription checked: `WebSocket#onClose` owns payload/transport policy; `Client#connect` owns the client's default socket policy.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback / edge | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Socket `close` event | #8012, native callback binding | `{event, reason, wasClean}` reads fields from the one event | event reference retained | method JSDoc | callback-shaped unit arm + native probe |
| `reconnectOnCleanClose` | #8177's abnormal-close default; explicit consumer policy | false by default; true includes clean code-1000 closure | abnormal closure still retries | config JSDoc | default/opt-in/abnormal matrix |
| Client-created socket | #18970 recovery contract | defaults clean-close retry to true | explicit config wins; supplied instance retained | connect/socketConfig JSDoc | clean bridge-close browser arm |
| Client explicit clean-close opt-out | socket policy + exhaustion-driven redial | clean close stays closed on window returns | abnormal loss still uses existing cycle | socketConfig JSDoc | opt-out browser control |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Native-shaped close callback emits the original event and its actual reason/wasClean fields.
- [ ] A generic socket does not automatically retry a clean code-1000 close; abnormal/non-1000 closes still retry.
- [ ] Opting in enables clean-close retry, and the default Neural Link client retains recovery after a clean bridge close.
- [ ] The client's explicit opt-out stays closed after a clean close and subsequent focus/visibility return; no implicit cycle is invented.
- [ ] Existing late-bridge, backoff and error-before-close controls stay green. New assertions fail on the corresponding missing field/policy behavior.

## Out of Scope

Changing the backoff budget, clean-close protocol codes, bridge server behavior, message queue semantics or unrelated connection lifecycle cleanup. No Brain runtime/config changes.

Decision Record impact: none — bounded transport-contract correction and explicit policy for its existing consumer.
